description: A flag documented as on in staging reverted to its default during a redeploy.
howSeeded: Redeployed the config service without the environment overlay, so the flag fell back to its default.
decidingEvidence: The remote-config audit trail showing the override present, then absent after redeploy, against a config file that still declares it on.
twinAxis: Same flag, same off state, but here the state is an accident: the redeploy dropped the override.
